entities.name: Query 87-aa membrane protein
observations: The protein is 87 amino acids long and contains one dominant hydrophobic segment spanning approximately residues 25–47, consistent with a single transmembrane helix.
The C-terminal region is rich in charged residues and includes an acidic/basic cytoplasmic-type tail; topology orientation cannot be proven from sequence alone.
The sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein Q57683 (MJ0230) from Methanocaldococcus jannaschii.
The matched reference is annotated as a membrane, single-pass membrane protein.
No Pfam domain result was returned; this does not establish absence of a domain.
